children.text: Through a diverse range of activities, students are encouraged to discover their passions, collaborate with peers, and become active contributors to the school community. Whether pursuing athletic excellence, artistic expression, intellectual challenges, or leadership opportunities, every student is empowered to grow, connect, and thrive.

heading.subtitle: Our extracurricular activities program provides students with opportunities to explore their interests, develop new talents, build confidence, and strengthen essential life skills.
heading.title: Learning Beyond the Classroom

cards.description:
Our sports programs promote physical fitness, teamwork, perseverance, and healthy competition. Students have opportunities to participate in a variety of individual and team-based activities that encourage discipline, resilience, and personal growth.

Through regular practice, friendly competitions, and school sporting events, students develop confidence, leadership skills, and a lifelong appreciation for active and healthy living.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi student playing the violin during a music lesson

cards.title: Sports & Physical Wellness

cards.description:
The arts provide students with meaningful opportunities to express creativity, imagination, and individuality. Through visual arts, music, drama, and performance-based activities, students explore different forms of artistic expression while developing their talents.

Participation in artistic programs enhances confidence, communication skills, and cultural appreciation, allowing students to showcase their abilities through performances, exhibitions, and special events.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students during a sports training session

cards.title: Arts, Music & Performance

cards.description:
Our academic enrichment activities encourage students to think critically, solve problems creatively, and pursue knowledge beyond the classroom curriculum. Programs such as chess, debate, puzzles, STEM challenges, and academic competitions inspire curiosity and intellectual growth.

These experiences help students strengthen analytical thinking, collaboration, and decision-making skills while fostering a love of learning and innovation.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students working together in a school club

cards.title: Academic & Intellectual Enrichment

cards.description:
Leadership opportunities empower students to take initiative, work collaboratively, and contribute positively to their school and wider community. Through student-led projects, service activities, and leadership programs, students learn the value of responsibility, integrity, and teamwork.

By engaging in meaningful community experiences, students develop empathy, communication skills, and a strong sense of citizenship, preparing them to become confident and responsible future leaders.

cards.title: Leadership & Community Engagement
